description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline's setPosition functionality within a media playback system. It defines a test fixture class that tests the behavior of setting the media position in various playback and network states, ensuring proper IPC communication and cleanup of data requests.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineSetPositionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the setPosition method of the media pipeline, verifying IPC calls and data request cleanup across different states.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates the media pipeline, and sets default playback state to playing.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment by destroying the media pipeline.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline, mocking the IPC attachSource call.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sends a setPosition command over IPC and verifies success.

methods.name: testNeedDataRequestRemovedOnSetPosition
methods.description: Tests that needData requests are removed after setting position in a given playback state.

methods.name: testNeedDataRequestRemovedOnSetPosition (NetworkState version)
methods.description: Tests that needData requests are removed after setting position in a given network state.
